description: The headless combobox core of the SvGrid UI kit in Svelte 5. SvComboBox is one styled renderer over createCombobox, which owns type-to-filter, the roving active index, the keyboard model, reverting unmatched text and ARIA, exposed as inputProps, triggerProps, listboxProps and optionProps. The same core drives the styled component and a custom filter-input render, both bound to one value with a readout.

faq.question: What do I have to render myself?
faq.answer: An input with inputProps(), an optional trigger with triggerProps(), a list with listboxProps() and one element per filtered option with optionProps(i). The core supplies the filtered options and the active index.

faq.question: How does unmatched text revert?
faq.answer: On blur the core compares the input text with the options and, if nothing matches, restores the last valid value, so your render does not need its own blur logic.

faq.question: Does the core know about the DOM?
faq.answer: No. It holds state and returns attributes; positioning and portalling are the styled component's concern, which is why an inline custom render works without a portal.
